moving_head_observation.note: Repository advanced during the audit; findings are bound to exact fetched blobs/commits where cited below. Shared workspace files were intentionally not rewritten by this audit.

scope: visual/MVC epoch and spatial descriptor evidence

summary.dominant_failure_pattern: identity/generation/attempt/provenance facts are often represented as ordinary values or hashes but are not closed into one immutable causal execution capability from ingress through provider precommit, verified outcome, re-entry and terminal DONE

findings.claim: V14 reservation/begin/retry is not bound to the caller-presented current V15/V16 execution generation; stale generations can reach COMMITTING.
findings.repair_obligation: immutable caller-bound execution-generation capability at reservation, begin/retry and provider-precommit; turnover routes uncertain attempts to reconciliation

findings.claim: Expired BUSY/RECOVERING presence can be directly replaced by a new BUSY holder without a validated recovery receipt.
findings.repair_obligation: expired holder -> RECOVERING -> validated recovery proof -> new generation, never direct takeover

findings.claim: Same holder can renew RECOVERING and release RECOVERING directly to IDLE; recovery is therefore not a strict fail-closed phase.
V15 event hash omits operation identity; distinct operations with equal semantic projection and injected timestamp can collide against UNIQUE(event_hash).
findings.repair_obligation: include immutable operation/event identity or sequence in event hash domain

findings.claim: confirm_idle_handoff binds only session_ref+client_ref and not released_lease_epoch, so stale confirmation can clear a newer handoff generation for the same holder.
V16 request_key_hash binds credential/session/client/request_id but no request payload/input digest; same request_id with changed semantic content is indistinguishable at admission.
findings.counterhypothesis: an outer HTTP/API layer may separately reject payload drift, but no such binding is present in the inspected durable admission core

findings.claim: A prior V16 admission can cause HTTP 200 IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY after restart even when there is no active execution and response_replay_available=false, risking a permanently lost request after crash-before-response.
findings.next_falsifier: admit request -> crash before response/terminal task state -> restart -> replay exact request and require either stored response or explicit recover/resume path, not empty-success replay

findings.claim: record_outcome and reconcile_uncertain_outcome accept no attempt_id; a late outcome from attempt A can be recorded after retry B replaced the row attempt_id, attributing A evidence to B.
findings.repair_obligation: every outcome/reconciliation receipt must bind exact attempt_id + provider operation/idempotency identity

findings.claim: reconcile_uncertain_outcome accepts any non-empty evidence dict plus success bool and writes outcome_verified=1 without a trusted provider receipt verifier.
findings.repair_obligation: trusted provider-specific reconciliation verifier producing an opaque receipt bound to attempt and provider object identity

findings.claim: V14 record_reentry accepts an arbitrary reentry dict after verified outcome and recovery_decision maps REENTERED directly to COMPLETE despite the current terminal-DONE requirement.
atomic effect reservation converts every sqlite3.IntegrityError into CANCELLED/INTEGRITY_CONFLICT, potentially masking schema/event/constraint defects as normal reservation conflict.

Individually valid but causally unrelated prediction outcome, credit, semantic record and free support snapshot symbol can be cross-spliced into a V17 terminal DONE chain while SQLite integrity remains OK.
findings.repair_obligation: relationally close verified provider outcome -> same-cycle causal use -> prediction outcome -> non-correlated effect credit -> admitted semantic delta -> reentry authority -> DONE

findings.claim: V17.1 trigger reads effect_reservations.outcome_evidence_clay, but inspected V14 schema does not define it and current V14 runtime stores only the evidence hash.
findings.repair_obligation: persist authoritative provider evidence/receipt relation before promoting V17.1; do not rely on a nonexistent column

findings.claim: V17.1 compares provider_receipt_hash strings extracted from JSON but the inspected candidate does not FK those hashes to an independently trusted provider-receipt authority table.
findings.next_falsifier: construct self-consistent forged provider_receipt_hash across effect/prediction rows; candidate must reject unless a trusted writer/attestation exists

findings.claim: repo_truth_gate still accepts schema 12.0/table subset while current runtime requires V14/V15/V16 features; a V12-only DB can therefore pass the global gate yet fail later runtime assumptions.
frank_prompt_capsule still hardcodes entity:frank / dr-unterweger-frank-personal-entity while owner-fixed native identity is self.root server-binary on target VPS.
Prompt capsule validates UnifiedDB/ClayGraph lineage, performs writes/commits, then reads both databases without one consistent cross-DB snapshot or post-read lineage revalidation.
findings.next_falsifier: concurrent materializer advances one projection between validation and capsule assembly; capsule must reject mixed epoch

findings.claim: frank.effects finish(VerifiedEffectReceipt) immediately returns DONE although the same source declares verified_outcome_requires_provenance_bound_reentry_before_done; recover_effect also sends EXECUTED directly to REENTRY_PENDING.

A directly constructed structural EffectRequest with authenticated/scoped facts is indistinguishable to the value-level policy oracle from the intended trusted request and can receive ALLOW for reversible write.
findings.epistemic_limit: not a production exploit claim; a complete WP04 module/type/effect boundary could make construction/call unreachable

findings.claim: WP04 checker v1 silently leaves unknown unqualified calls without an effect classification. v2 adds explicit UNCLASSIFIED_EXTERNAL_CALL, but is still a wrapper over v1 rather than the promoted general checker.
effect_checker_v2 temporarily monkey-patches v1.resolve_function_call globally; concurrent v1/v2 checks in one process can race and observe the wrong resolution policy.
findings.next_falsifier: parallelize v1 and v2 infer_effects with deterministic unknown-call corpus and assert policy isolation

findings.claim: IngressExecutionLease.release marks the wrapper released and clears the active route in finally even when semantic release/clear raises; retry heartbeat/release through that object becomes impossible.
FrankExecutionLease.release always closes/unlocks flock in finally even if V15 semantic release raises, allowing physical exclusion to disappear while semantic release did not complete cleanly.
A fork child inheriting the flock open-file-description can keep physical exclusion alive after parent crash and semantic TTL expiry; recovery is blocked until the last inherited descriptor closes.
findings.interpretation: safety exclusion holds, but liveness/recovery can stall indefinitely if a descendant leaks the inherited descriptor

findings.claim: Hive.join appends ExecutionNode records while route derives liveness by node.id; if SET equality is structural rather than keyed by id, an older same-id record with broader capabilities can become routable again when fresh evidence marks that id active.
findings.counterhypothesis: ClayCode SET may enforce identity-key uniqueness, but that is not explicit in the inspected semantic source

findings.claim: The old global/token-order bucket visual descriptor can collide for left/right layout swaps; a geometry-bound 2D spatial pyramid separates the control.
findings.epistemic_limit: real mtmd grid metadata and real Qwen embeddings were not measured in that receipt

findings.claim: A nominal pairwise+context model can exactly fit a third-order relation by smuggling a relation member through context; reduction validity therefore requires material-read closure excluding relation members/derived members.
findings.epistemic_limit: validator semantics; not evidence that production Hyperposition already performs this smuggling

findings.claim: Canonical state opener forces WAL. Project guard correctly treats upstream affected SQLite versions as blocked until exact distro/backport provenance or a machine-checked topology exclusion proves safety.
findings.epistemic_limit: do not claim target corruption without exact Ubuntu SQLite package/backport evidence

priority_repair_order: close execution-generation + exact-attempt + provider-precommit/outcome fence as one capability chain
make RECOVERING a hard barrier and make handoff confirmation generation-bound
repair ingress/physical release exception semantics so physical lock is not dropped on failed semantic transition
replace asserted reconciliation/provider hash strings with trusted provider receipts
align V17.1 schema/runtime and close causal admission relationally
upgrade repo truth/schema feature gate to current required V14-V16+ semantics
finish self.root prompt/identity migration and cross-DB epoch consistency
make ClayCode semantic finish/recovery paths obey provenance-bound reentry-before-DONE
promote closed-world WP04 effect checking without process-global monkey-patching
resolve WAL package/topology safety before release
run snapshot rollback generation-resurrection and crash/restart replay gates
apply geometry-bound visual descriptors and context-admissible Hyperposition validators only after real target evidence
strongest_counterhypothesis: Several current-main Python paths may remain scaffolding that production ClayCode/type-effect/runtime boundaries never expose; if exact end-to-end target-VPS compilation proves those paths unreachable and the compiled boundary enforces immutable generation/attempt/provider capabilities, some static findings downgrade from exploitable runtime defects to dead-code or migration debt.
next_discriminating_suite: stale generation A -> takeover B -> reserve/begin/provider-precommit from A must all fail
retry B -> delayed provider receipt from attempt A must fail attribution
crash-after-admission-before-response -> restart -> exact request must resume/replay response or explicitly reconcile, never ghost-success
release DB failure injection -> physical flock remains held or recovery proof is atomically committed before unlock
V17.1 forged self-consistent provider hash chain must fail without trusted provider receipt
V12-only DB must fail current feature gate before runtime opens
parallel WP04 v1/v2 checks must be policy-isolated
snapshot rollback must advance non-rollback incarnation and reject pre-restore capabilities
real mtmd/Qwen held-out spatial collision/epoch bridge test
Hyperposition context dependency closure test on real candidate features

architecture_delta.name: EXECUTION_CAUSAL_CAPABILITY_SPINE
architecture_delta.proposal: Represent one opaque immutable chain from authenticated ingress request digest + execution incarnation/lease epoch + exact attempt + effect authorization/reservation + provider operation receipt + verified outcome + causal-use/admitted-delta receipt + terminal DONE. All mutable/global-current observations become validation inputs, never substitute for the caller-presented chain.
architecture_delta.rollback: retain current V14-V16/V17 candidate schemas and run new spine in shadow until differential crash/replay/provider tests pass

research_write_scope: receipt only; no Frank code, harness, workspace status, canonical state or owner directive modified
